context_requirements: Expression of SQLE and an intact sterol regulatory element-binding protein (SREBP) pathway
Active cholesterol biosynthesis and dependence on the mevalonate pathway
Cellular capacity to sense sterol depletion and upregulate SREBP target genes
falsifiers: No consistent upregulation of SREBP target genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1, SQLE) at 6 or 24 hours in any cell line
Lack of dose-dependent transcriptional response across the nine cell lines
Predominant downregulation of cholesterol biosynthesis genes instead of compensatory upregulation
